provider: VmShell Hong Kong CMI port forward

egress.terms: [translated] 'Free for one month', with no traffic allowance, rate or session length stated. The notice describes it as a test product with no technical support.; ingress: tcp

interface_detail: [translated] The notice gives a vmshell.com cart link and a Telegram support group; no client or API is described.
tooling: panel-configured port forward; no client documented in the notice
chaining: A Hong Kong forward on a high port would front a service that speaks on 13800-59999, for one month.
binding_note: The month ends before 1 TiB/month can be reached, and the notice publishes no byte allowance to fail first.

identity_cost.detail: [translated] 'Limit: one product per ID', ordered through a vmshell.com cart link. The notice does not state what registration requires.

reliability_note: Described by the vendor as a test product with no technical support; the blocked port list removes 22, 80, 443 and 3306.
confidence_note: A third-party blog reproducing the vendor's Telegram notice dated 2023-01-23. The vendor page was not read and the notice is three years old, so whether the trial still runs is not established. Reading vmshell.com/cart.php?a=add&pid=76 would settle it.
notes: A free Hong Kong port forward on China Telecom's CMI route, which is the shape that matters for a Hong Kong address a mainland-facing service will accept. It is a one-month test product announced in January 2023 with no support. The admin ports 22, 443, 80 and 3306 are blocked, so it can never host SSH or TLS on the usual ports. Country: Hong Kong. Whether UDP exists in the allowed range is the one question that would change the verdict and the notice does not answer it.

extras.wg_detail: [translated] The notice names a port range (13800-59999) and no protocol. A TCP-only forward could not carry a WireGuard datagram; whether UDP is forwarded in that range is not stated by the notice.
extras.volume_stated: [translated] 'Free for one month', with no traffic allowance, rate or session length stated. The notice describes it as a test product with no technical support.
extras.transit_note: VmShell's Hong Kong CMI address forwards to the client's machine.
